verdict.rationale: Statsig documents programmatic flag management: the Console API is the CRUD API for everything available in the console, the CLI manages Feature Gates and can run in CI/CD, and an official MCP server connects to AI tools (though its documented use is asking questions and exploring data, not writing changes). The evidence has nothing on approval workflows or required reviews that would force an agent's flag changes through sign-off before reaching production; SSO/SCIM access management is an adjacent control and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented approval/review workflows gating flag changes, evidence that MCP can create/toggle flags, policy enforcement that keeps API or CLI writes from reaching production unreviewed, independent corroboration.
